changelog: GitHub App OAuth: Connect directly with GitHub App (OAuth flow with custom callback scheme antigem://oauth/callback, automatic token exchange, user profile display)
DeepSeek Harness: Full integration with DeepSeek V3, R1, and Coder models via ACP (Agent Client Protocol), including model picker, API key config, profile selector, and connection test
Unified AI Providers & Custom Providers: Add any OpenAI or Anthropic compatible endpoint with built-in presets for Kimi, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Z.ai
Overhauled Marketplace: Redesigned with category filters, rich plugin cards, detail sheets, and 15+ real plugins (Slack, Notion, Linear, Jira, Figma, Stripe, OpenAI, etc.)
Enhanced Codex & Claude integration with automatic CLI detection and custom provider shortcut
Cleaned up UI architecture and optimized memory footprint
Fixed OpenCode custom providers whose models didn't show up in the model list or in chat (newer OpenCode versions)
Added Images, Reasoning and Tools switches for each model of an OpenCode custom provider
"Fetch from endpoint" now detects which models read images, think or use tools (from the endpoint, Ollama or models.dev)
Redesigned the custom provider editor: full screen, fast with hundreds of models, with search, filters and select all
Added Effort and Thinking controls to OpenCode chats for models that support them
The chat now warns when you attach an image to an OpenCode model that can't read images
Fixed the app not starting on Android 7 and 8
Back on the main chat screen now moves AntiGem to the background instead of closing it
